description: This file defines the LoanTopupDetails entity class, which models the details related to a loan top-up, including relationship to the Loan, closure loan ID, transfer details, and amount.

classes.name: LoanTopupDetails
classes.description: Entity class representing details of a loan top-up, including relationships to Loan and fields for top-up amount and related IDs.

methods.name: LoanTopupDetails
methods.description: Constructor to initialize LoanTopupDetails with a loan and the ID of the loan to close.

methods.name: getLoanIdToClose
methods.description: Returns the ID of the loan to close during the top-up process.

methods.name: getTopupAmount
methods.description: Returns the amount of the top-up.

methods.name: setTopupAmount
methods.description: Sets the amount for the top-up.

methods.name: setAccountTransferDetails
methods.description: Sets the account transfer details ID related to the top-up.
